# TextArea

Text area — free text over several lines, on `_Field`. The field is 80 high at least, and `rows` grows it from there. With `maxLength`, the caption counts characters on the right. With `appearance="subtle"`, it reads as plain text until hovered or edited, shows Save and Cancel while editing, and stays open when it loses focus.

Also asked as: multi-line, multiline text, long text input, notes field, comment box.

**Import:** `import { TextArea } from '@/components';`

## Usage

Use a Text area for free text over several lines: session notes, feedback, a
reason. Use a Text field for one short answer, and a Rich text editor only when
the text needs formatting.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name the field with a short noun: "Email address". | An instruction where the name belongs: "Enter your email address here". |
| Use sentence case and no end punctuation on labels. | Title case, or a period after the label. |
| Say what to do about an error: "Enter a 10-digit number." | "Invalid" or "Error". |
| Keep helper text to one short line. | Paragraphs in the caption. Link to help instead. |

## Best practices

### Hint at the answer, not the control. {#hint-at-the-answer-not-the-control}

A placeholder shows what a good answer looks like.

Do: Hint names the answer.
Don't: Hint describes the control.

### Show an error on the field itself. {#show-an-error-on-the-field-itself}

The field carries the invalid state. Use `isInvalid` only when the form cannot go on.

Do: The field shows the invalid state.
Don't: A default field gives no sign of the problem.

### Disable instead of hiding. {#disable-instead-of-hiding}

A disabled field tells people the option exists but is unavailable.

Do: Visible but disabled.
Don't: An enabled field that cannot take input.

### Put help in the caption. {#put-help-in-the-caption}

Do: Put help in the caption, where it stays after the person types.
Don't: Help in the placeholder disappears when the person starts typing.

### Match `rows` to the expected answer. {#match-rows-to-the-expected-answer}

One row is a short note; six rows is a paragraph. The box starts at 80 whatever `rows` says.

### Set a count only for a real limit. {#set-a-count-only-for-a-real-limit}

Set `maxLength` when something downstream truncates; do not add a limit just to show a count.

### Use subtle for editing in place. {#use-subtle-for-editing-in-place}

`appearance="subtle"` shows Save and Cancel while editing and does not save when focus leaves the field, so a click elsewhere in the middle of a paragraph does not publish half a thought.

### Let a warning accept the value. {#let-a-warning-accept-the-value}

`warningMessage` draws the warning edge and `successMessage` the success edge, each with its message. The value is accepted in both.

## Accessibility

- **The label is associated whether you pass `id` or not**, and `isLabelHidden`
  clips it out of sight without removing the name.
- **An error is announced.** `isInvalid` sets `aria-invalid` and renders the
  message with `role="alert"`; a warning, a success message and standing help are
  described. A count is part of the description.
- **Focus is a ring**, with no change of fill.
- **Save and Cancel are real buttons**, reached in the tab order after the field.
  Esc cancels, and Ctrl or Cmd with Enter saves.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | The `id` of the `textarea`; the label points at it. Generated when omitted. |
| `name` | string | — | The form key the text submits under. |
| `label` | node | — | The visible label above the field. Hide it with `isLabelHidden`. |
| `isRequired` | bool | `false` | Shows an asterisk and sets `aria-required`. |
| `isLabelHidden` | bool | `false` | Hides the label without removing it. |
| `info` | node | — | Text for an info tooltip beside the label. |
| `caption` | node | — | Standing help under the field. A message takes its place. |
| `value` | string | — | The text. Pass it, with `onChange`, to control the field. |
| `defaultValue` | string | — | The text to start with when the field is uncontrolled. |
| `placeholder` | string | — | Hint text shown while the field is empty. |
| `rows` | number | `3` | Visible lines of text. One row is the short textarea. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | `default` starts at 80 high with 10 corners; `compact` has 8 corners, to sit beside a 32 field. |
| `appearance` | enum | `'standard'` | `subtle` is borderless until hovered or edited, with Save and Cancel while editing. |
| `isDisabled` | bool | `false` | Dims the field and blocks focus and editing. |
| `isReadOnly` | bool | `false` | Shows the text and keeps it focusable, but it cannot be changed. |
| `isInvalid` | bool | `false` | Draws the error border and sets `aria-invalid`; `errorMessage` says why. |
| `errorMessage` | node | — | The caption shown under the field while `isInvalid` is set. It replaces `caption`. |
| `warningMessage` | node | — | Draws the warning border. Does not set `aria-invalid`: the value is accepted. |
| `successMessage` | node | — | Draws the confirmation border. |
| `maxLength` | number | — | Limits the length and shows a count on the right of the caption. |
| `onSave` | func | — | Subtle only: called by Save (or Ctrl/⌘+Enter). Throw or reject to keep the field open in `invalid`. |
| `onChange` | func | — | Called with the change event on each edit. |
| `onFocus` | func | — | Called with the focus event when the field gains focus. |
| `onBlur` | func | — | Called with the blur event when the field loses focus. |
| `onKeyDown` | func | — | Called with the keydown event. Call `preventDefault` to stop the subtle appearance's own key handling. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class names added to the field wrapper beside the component's own. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline styles for the field wrapper. |

## Variants

**`spacing`** — `default` · `compact`

**`appearance`** — `standard` · `subtle`

Anything not listed is not a valid value.
